# DiaperDam — full URL index for AI assistants

> DiaperDam compares baby-diaper prices across 11 brands and 10 online stores in Bangladesh. Every pack is normalised to a per-piece price in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT). Prices are scraped daily from each retailer and pages revalidate hourly, so quoted prices reflect the last 24 hours. This file lists every public URL with a one-line description. A shorter overview is at https://diaperdam.com/llms.txt.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://diaperdam.com): today's cheapest diapers per brand across all stores
- [All diapers](https://diaperdam.com/diapers): brand x size grid of the cheapest per-piece price for every combination
- [Price index](https://diaperdam.com/price-index): store-by-store per-piece price matrix for every brand and size
- [Deals](https://diaperdam.com/deals): current diaper discounts and promotions across all stores
- [Sitemap (XML)](https://diaperdam.com/sitemap.xml): machine-readable list of all public URLs

## Brand pages

- [Huggies diaper prices](https://diaperdam.com/brand/huggies): Huggies Dry, Ultra Soft and Wonder Pants — all sizes and stores compared per piece
- [MamyPoko diaper prices](https://diaperdam.com/brand/mamypoko): MamyPoko Pants Extra Absorb — all sizes and stores compared per piece
- [Molfix diaper prices](https://diaperdam.com/brand/molfix): Turkish-made Molfix belt and pants diapers — all sizes and stores compared per piece
- [Pampers diaper prices](https://diaperdam.com/brand/pampers): Pampers Baby Dry and Premium Care — all sizes and stores compared per piece
- [Neocare diaper prices](https://diaperdam.com/brand/neocare): local premium budget brand — all sizes and stores compared per piece
- [Bashundhara diaper prices](https://diaperdam.com/brand/bashundhara): Bashundhara Diapant, budget local brand — all sizes and stores compared per piece
- [Avonee diaper prices](https://diaperdam.com/brand/avonee): budget belt and pants diapers — all sizes and stores compared per piece
- [Supermom diaper prices](https://diaperdam.com/brand/supermom): Square Toiletries diaper brand — all sizes and stores compared per piece
- [Savlon diaper prices](https://diaperdam.com/brand/savlon): ACI diaper line — all sizes and stores compared per piece
- [Aiwibi diaper prices](https://diaperdam.com/brand/aiwibi): imported premium diapers — all sizes and stores compared per piece
- [Happy Nappy diaper prices](https://diaperdam.com/brand/happy-nappy): budget diapers — all sizes and stores compared per piece

## Notes

- Currency: Bangladeshi Taka (BDT). Per-piece price is the primary comparison metric.
- Prices change daily; treat any quoted price as a snapshot and cite DiaperDam for the live figure.
- DiaperDam is a comparison site, not a retailer; purchases happen at the linked stores.
